title: Print boards
intro: Make PDF boards for paper play. Works offline.
seedNote: Write this code down for the cantor. It is used to check paper boards.
largeHelp: One board per page, with bigger type.
inkHelp: No background colours and thin lines.
noPhoneBody: Print the boards, hand out beans and let the cantor use the screen. To check a paper board, the cantor types its 6-character code.
degraded: The PDF used a basic typeface because the regular one could not load. Some letters in names may be missing.
